wow.notes: dist/index.html: Layer Gauge as a persistent scroll-synced margin rail is a distinctive conceptual tool tied to the thesis. The estimator provides sample price ranges with honest disclaimers. Multi-step form with room/size/timing/contact flow is practical. However, without screenshots cannot verify the signature moment executes visually or that the gauge animation delivers the 'one thing a homeowner would show their partner' impact.

elevate.move: Replace placeholder frames with niche-approved media from the demolition manifest; apply the concept's duotone treatment (charcoal deep + safety orange tint) so photos read as one controlled shoot rather than stock fills

Break the four consecutive .stack process sections into distinct layout families — make containment a split with pinned photo, shutoffs a horizontal step-timeline, testing an asymmetric callout, and debris a full-bleed dark band — so the scroll rhythm alternates density instead of repeating the same centered column
